blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: With the rapid development of vision-language models (VLMs), Web-GUI agents have achieved promising performance in interacting with real-world interfaces through screenshot-based grounding. However, high-resolution screenshots and multi-turn histories introduce excessive visual tokens, causing substantial inference overhead. Existing token pruning methods, mainly designed for natural images, often select tokens independently based on importance scores, which can fragment the local visual structures required for recognizing small GUI elements such as buttons, icons, and hyperlinks. In this work, we propose STP-GUI (Spatially-aware Token Pruning for GUI agents), a query-guided token pruning framework that preserves fine-grained instruction-conditioned token scoring while performing spatially coherent window-level selection under aggressive token reduction. A lightweight selector is optimized through policy learning while the VLM backbone remains frozen. Experiments on Online-Mind2Web show that \papername achieves a favorable efficiency-performance tradeoff under low token budgets. At 21% token retention, it preserves 77.7% of full-token performance while reducing inference latency by 31% and FLOPs by 57%. Results on Android in the Wild further suggest that the method transfers to mobile GUI environments.
blocks.zh: 随着视觉语言模型(VLMs)的快速发展,Web-GUI代理商通过基于截图的地面,在与现实世界界面的互动中取得了有希望的性能. 然而,高分辨率截图和多回合历史引入了过多的视觉符号,造成了大量的推论间接. 主要为自然图像而设计的现有令牌刷新方法,经常根据重要性分数独立选择令牌,这可以分割识别按钮,图标,超链接等小型GUI元素所需的局部视觉结构. 在这项工作中,我们提出STP-GUI(Spatial-aware Token Pruning for GUI 代理商),这是一个查询引导的符号推算框架,它保留了精细的教学条件的符号评分,同时在积极的符号减少下进行空间一致的窗口级选择。 轻量级选择器通过政策学习得到优化,而VLM主干线仍然被冻结。 在Online-Mind2Web上的实验显示,\papername在低标价预算下实现了有利的效率性能权衡. 在21%的象征性保留下,它保留了77.7%的全托性能,同时将推断延迟率降低31%,FLOPs降低57%. 荒野中Android的结果进一步表明,该方法向移动GUI环境转移.

blocks.en: With the rapid development of vision-language models (VLMs), Web-GUI agents that navigate real websites by grounding actions in screenshots and text instructions have seen growing adoption Fu et al. (2025) ; Wang et al. (2025) ; Bai et al. (2025a) ; Bai et al. (2025b) ; Wang et al. (2024a) . This setting requires high-resolution visual inputs to resolve small interactive elements such as hyperlinks, icons, and drop-down menus. The cost is a large visual token sequence: for instance, Qwen3-VL Bai et al. (2025a) encodes a single 1920 × \times 1080 screenshot into approximately 2,040 visual tokens. Furthermore, as is a common practice in Web-GUI agent systems Fu et al. (2025) ; Qin et al. (2025) ; Wang et al. (2025) ; Bai et al. (2024) , agents receive multiple interaction history—prior screenshots, actions, and observations—at each step, which can easily push the total visual token count beyond 10K. These large prefill token counts severely bottleneck inference, yet users are sensitive to agent response latency. Reducing visual token load is therefore a practical challenge.

blocks.en: A straightforward strategy is to prune visual tokens before input the LLM modules, as has been studied for VLM Shen et al. (2025) ; Shang et al. (2025) ; Yang et al. (2025) . Web-GUI screenshots, however, pose distinct challenges that make standard pruning strategies unreliable. First, informative regions are sparse, localized, and often tiny—a single icon or hyperlink may occupy only a handful of visual tokens—while most of the page consists of blank background, repeated layout blocks, or decorative structure. Second, the spatial continuity of these small regions is essential: losing a few adjacent patches can destroy the visual evidence needed to identify a clickable element. These characteristics make pruning strategies designed for natural images Jizhihui et al. (2026) ; Xing et al. (2024) , where foreground objects are large and continuous, a poor fit for web interfaces.
blocks.zh: 一种直接的策略是,在输入LLM模块之前先放出可视化符号,正如对VLM的研究 沈等 (2025); 相克等 (2025); 杨等 (2025). 然而,Web-GUI截图带来了出乎意料的挑战,使得标准的打压策略不可靠. 首先,信息丰富的区域稀少,局部化,而且往往很小——一个单一的图标或超链接可能只占据少数可视符号——而大部分页面由空白背景、重复的布局块或装饰结构组成。 第二,这些小区域的空间连续性至关重要:失去几个相邻的补丁会破坏识别可点击元素所需的视觉证据. 这些特征使得为自然影像Jizhihui等(2026年);Xing等(2024年)所设计的穿梭策略,其中前地物体大而连续,不适于网页界面.

blocks.en: As illustrated in Fig. 1 , we propose STP-GUI ( S patially-aware T oken P runing for GUI agents), a query–guided token pruning method that selects spatially contiguous windows rather than isolated tokens. Concretely, STP-GUI first computes token - wise importance scores using a lightweight query–conditioned scoring module, aggregates the scores within W × W W{\times}W windows, and then uses a Plackett–Luce policy during training to learn which windows to retain. At inference time, windows are selected greedily by score rank under a fixed token budget, while the VLM backbone remains frozen throughout. This design preserves fine - grained token scoring while reducing spatial fragmentation of the retained set, thereby helping the model preserve local evidence around GUI elements such as buttons, icons, and label - field pairs. Experiments on Online-Mind2Web (300 tasks across 136 live websites) Xue et al. (2025) show that STP-GUI is particularly competitive at low retention budgets. By evaluating on Android in the Wild (AitW) Rawles et al. (2023) , we further show that the same design transfers beyond web screenshots to mobile GUI settings. At 21% token retention, it achieves the strongest success rate among the compared methods reported at their evaluated operating points while reducing inference latency by 31% and FLOPs by 57% relative to the dense baseline. Our main contributions are summarized as: • We identify a previously overlooked failure mode of GUI-agent token pruning: coupling importance estimation and selection granularity causes spatial fragmentation of action-relevant visual evidence. • We introduce STP-GUI, a granularity-decoupled selection paradigm that scores tokens precisely while selecting contiguous windows to preserve spatial coherence. • We formulate GUI visual token retention as a budget-constrained discrete selection problem and design a lightweight query-conditioned selector trained with policy learning, while keeping the VLM backbone frozen. • Experiments on Online-Mind2Web show that STP-GUI provides a favorable tradeoff between accuracy and efficiency under token pruning, reducing inference latency by 31% and FLOPs by 57%. Results on AitW also show the generalization for mobile GUI environments.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Early GUI agents relied on modular pipelines combining text extraction, reasoning, and memory components Hurst et al. (2024) ; Xie et al. (2024) , which can be brittle under changing environments Xia et al. (2024) . Recent VLM-based agents instead directly ground actions from screenshots and achieve stronger generalization on benchmarks such as Mind2Web and AitW Wang et al. (2024b) ; Hong et al. (2024) ; Chen et al. (2025) . Meanwhile, mobile GUI agents further improve grounding through specialized training pipelines Tang et al. (2025) . However, regardless of agent architecture, high-resolution visual inputs introduce substantial token overhead, making efficient visual token selection an important problem for deployment.
blocks.zh: 早期的图形用户界面代理依赖于组合文本提取、推理和内存组件的模块化管道 Hurst等 (2024); Xie等 (2024),在变化中的环境下可以变得脆. Xia等 (2024). 近期以VLM为主的剂取而代之的是直接从截图上取出地面动作,并更有力地概括了Mind2Web和AitW Wang等(2024b)等基准;Hong等(2024);Chen等(2025). 同时,移动GUI代理商通过专业培训管道唐等(2025)进一步改善了地基布局. 然而,无论代理架构如何,高分辨的视觉输入都引入了实质性的标志性间接费用,使高效的视觉标志性选择成为部署的重要问题.

blocks.en:
Token pruning reduces the inference cost of VLMs by removing redundant visual tokens. Existing approaches can be broadly categorized into training-based and training-free methods Bolya et al. (2022) .
Training-based methods, such as ATP-LLaVA Ye et al. (2025) , learn adaptive pruning policies or ratios, while STP-GUI instead freezes the VLM backbone and optimizes a lightweight query-conditioned selector for spatially coherent pruning.
Training-free methods mainly rely on importance-based scoring (e.g., FastV Chen et al. (2024) , SparseVLM Zhang et al. (2024) , MustDrop Liu et al. (2024) , PDrop Xing et al. (2024) ) or redundancy-based filtering (e.g., DART Wen et al. (2025) , DivPrune Alvar et al. (2025) ).
However, these methods are primarily designed for natural images and select tokens independently, which may fragment the spatial evidence required for GUI grounding. STP-GUI addresses this limitation by decoupling token relevance estimation from evidence retention granularity, enabling spatially coherent token selection under constrained budgets.
blocks.zh:
Token pruning通过去掉多余的视觉符号来降低VLM的推断成本. 现行办法可大致分为基于培训和无培训方法Bolya等人(2022年)。
基于培训的方法,例如ATP-LLAVA Ye等人(2025年),学习适应性穿行政策或比率,而STP-GUI则将VLM主干网冻结并优化了一个轻量级的查询条件选择器来进行空间连贯穿行.

然而,这些方法主要是为自然图像而设计的,并且独立地选择了符号,这可能会使GUI搁浅所需的空间证据被打碎. STP-GUI通过将象征性相关性估计与证据保留颗粒性脱钩来解决这一限制,从而能够在有限的预算下进行空间上一致的符号选择。

Recent works improve GUI grounding through richer supervision or region-aware representations. For example, Gao et al. Gao et al. (2024) enhance vision-language alignment with region-level supervision, YORO Ho et al. (2022) develops efficient visual grounding models, and R-VLM Park et al. (2025) introduces region-aware visual representations for GUI grounding.
Different from these approaches, STP-GUI addresses visual token reduction for a frozen GUI agent rather than modifying the grounding backbone. Its selector uses action-level supervision and/or
full-token model feedback, without requiring
token-retention masks or UI-element bounding boxes.

blocks.en: Online-Mind2Web Xue et al. (2025) is a live web agent benchmark comprising 300 tasks across 136 real websites, using task-level success rate (SR) as the primary metric. Tasks require end-to-end interaction with live pages, making them sensitive to spatial-localization errors introduced by aggressive token pruning. Android in the Wild (AitW) Rawles et al. (2023) is a large-scale mobile GUI dataset spanning diverse app categories. Following Bai et al. (2024) , we evaluate on the General and Web Shopping test splits to assess cross-domain transferability of STP-GUI.
blocks.zh: 在线- Mind2网 薛等 (2025年)是一个活网代理基准,由136个真实网站的300项任务组成,以任务级别成功率(SR)为主要衡量标准. 任务需要与活页进行端到端的交互,使其敏感地意识到由侵略性的令牌穿行引入的空间-本地化错误. Android in the Wild (AitW) Rawles等 (2023)是一款涵盖不同应用类别的大型移动GUI数据集. 继Bai等人(2024年)之后,我们在一般和网络购物测试中进行了评估,以评估STP-GUI的跨域可转让性。

blocks.en: We used Qwen3-VL as the backbone model for our experiments. We construct the Web-GUI supervised training data following prior work Qin et al. (2025) ; Wang et al. (2025) ; Fu et al. (2025) . For Online-Mind2Web and AitW, we separately obtain the corresponding backbones by supervised fine-tuning(SFT) Qwen3-VL on their training data. STP-GUI and all pruning baselines are evaluated on top of these SFT backbones. We only performed SFT as the baseline and developing advanced RL method to achieve a higher accuracy is beyond the scope of this paper.
blocks.zh: 我们用Quen3-VL作为实验的主干模型. 我们根据先前的工作构建了Web-GUI监督培训数据。 对于Online-Mind2Wb和AitW,我们分别通过监督微调(SFT)Qune3-VL在其培训数据上获得相应的骨干. STP-GUI和所有跑动基线均在这些SFT主干线上被评价. 我们只是将SFT作为基线,开发先进的RL方法以达到更高的准确性,超出了本文的范围.

blocks.en:
We fine-tune Qwen3-VL as the base model using LLaMA-Factory Zheng et al. (2024) on 8 × \times A100 (80G) GPUs for 3 epochs with an initial learning rate of 1 ​ e- ​ 5 1\text{e-}5 and a cosine decay schedule. During SFT, the ViT encoder is frozen, while the adapter and LLM parameters are updated. After SFT, the VLM backbone is completely frozen for token pruning. STP-GUI only optimizes a lightweight 2M-parameter selector for window retention, without updating any VLM parameters. Unlike pruning methods that adapt VLM parameters during optimization, STP-GUI introduces only a small selection module that can be trained offline and deployed on top of the frozen backbone. The detailed tuning cost comparison with adapted pruning baselines is provided in appendix.
Training the selector takes approximately 10 hours on 8 GPUs. This additional cost is incurred only once offline, while the learned selector reduces inference latency by 31% and FLOPs by 57% during deployment.

blocks.en: To examine whether the benefit of STP-GUI extends beyond Online-Mind2Web, we additionally evaluate it on AitW, a mobile UI grounding benchmark with different interface layouts, visual styles, and action distributions. Following prior work Bai et al. (2024) ; Feng et al. (2025) , we report results on the General and Web Shopping splits. As shown in Tab. 2 , all compared methods are evaluated on top of backbones separately fine-tuned on the AitW training data, and we keep the pruning configurations consistent with those used in the main experiments. For PDrop, the retained token ratio is determined by its progressive halving design across 3 layers. Under the same 50% budget, STP-GUI outperforms Attention by a large margin on both splits (0.741 vs. 0.338 on General, 0.492 vs. 0.338 on Web Shopping), showing that the advantage of STP-GUI is not limited to the web setting. At the more aggressive 21% keep ratio, STP-GUI still maintains strong transfer performance, achieving 0.718 on General and 0.436 on Web Shopping. Because not all baselines are evaluated at exactly the same keep ratio, we do not claim a strict iso-budget comparison for every entry in Tab. 2 . Rather, these results show that STP-GUI remains competitive when the token budget is tightened substantially below the operating points used by several competing methods.

blocks.en: Beyond task success rate, we further analyze the spatial structure of the retained tokens. This analysis is motivated by the window-size ablation in 4 : when W = 1 W{=}1 degenerates to token-wise selection, performance drops at the same keep ratio, suggesting that how retained tokens are organized in space may matter. Ideally, one would also measure whether the retained tokens continue to cover the action-critical target region at each interaction step. However, such a dataset-level evaluation is not directly available in either Online-Mind2Web or AitW: these benchmarks do not provide dense per-step UI-element annotations for complete trajectories, and successful interaction paths are not unique. We therefore focus on a trajectory-level analysis of the binary retention masks produced by different pruning methods at the same 21% budget, using 4 connected-component statistics (8-connected-component statistics are shown in appendix) as a quantitative measure of spatial fragmentation, and complement this with manually curated case studies in the appendix, where we annotate step-level targets for representative successful Online-Mind2Web episodes and compare them with the retained token regions.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we present STP-GUI, a spatially-aware visual token pruning method for Web-GUI agents. By combining query-guided scoring with window-level selection, STP-GUI preserves action-relevant local evidence as contiguous patches under constrained token budgets. On Online-Mind2Web, it retains 93.8% of full-token performance at 50% retention and 77.7% at 21% retention, while reducing latency by 31% and FLOPs by 57%. These results show that lightweight pre-LLM pruning is a practical design for GUI agents operating under aggressive token constraints.

Additionally, STP-GUI uses a fixed token budget and predefined non-overlapping window granularity, which may be less suitable for interface elements that span window boundaries. Nevertheless, high-resolution encodings preserve sufficient token signals, and our overlap ablation (Tab. 5 ) suggests that coarse locality outweighs strict boundary alignment in practice.

blocks.en: A.1 More Implementation Details

blocks.en: For comparison methods, we re-implement each method Xing et al. (2024) ; Jizhihui et al. (2026) ; Sun et al. (2026) ; Cai et al. (2025) on top of Qwen3-VL using their official codebases. To ensure a fair comparison, we evaluate both their original training-free configurations and fine-tuned variants adapted on the same SFT data. Layer-sensitive baselines are evaluated using their best-performing configurations. Detailed sensitivity analyses are provided in appendix. Because Online-Mind2Web is conducted on live websites, we further assess evaluation stability by repeating all experiments 3 times under the same protocol and report the mean success rate in the main results. Across runs, the difference between the highest and lowest success rates never exceeds 5 successful tasks out of 300 (0.017 absolute SR). Since the performance gap between STP-GUI and the strongest competing baseline is larger than this fluctuation range, the main conclusions are unlikely to be explained by run-to-run evaluation noise alone. We use the action space defined in the agent prompt, which includes discrete action types with optional text or spatial arguments, such as clicking, hotkey invocation, scrolling, and termination.

blocks.en: A.3 Training Cost
blocks.zh: A.3 培训费用

blocks.en:
Table 9 reports the tuning cost of STP-GUI and the adapted training-based baselines under the same Qwen3-VL-2B setting. All adapted methods are trained with their official implementations on the same SFT data used to train STP-GUI.
The adapted methods require comparable or larger optimization budgets than STP-GUI. For example, HiPrune requires 10.3–14.1 hours and Attention requires 9.7–11.0 hours, while STP-GUI takes 4.8 hours when trained with ground-truth rewards only and 10.6 hours with the combined reward. Unlike the baselines, which update a subset of VLM parameters during training, STP-GUI only optimizes a lightweight 2M-parameter selector while keeping the VLM backbone fully frozen. When ground-truth action supervision is available, STP-GUI can be trained without the additional cost of offline full-model rollouts, making the GT-only variant a practical option for budget-constrained settings.

blocks.en: A.9 Step-wise Visualization of Fragmentation Patterns
blocks.zh: A.9 分解模式的分步可视化

blocks.en: Fig. 5 shows a qualitative visualization of STP-GUI’s token selection across 4 sequential steps of a representative Online-Mind2Web task. Because Online-Mind2Web and AitW do not provide dense per-step target annotations for complete trajectories, and successful interaction paths are not unique, we do not treat such examples as a dataset-level metric. Instead, we manually curate several successful Online-Mind2Web episodes as case studies, annotate the step-level ground-truth targets for those representative steps, and compare them with the retained token regions. In these cases, the selector concentrates the token budget on spatially coherent regions (navigation menus, product cards, and pricing tables), while discarding large uniform backgrounds. Token-wise pruning risks fragmenting contiguous GUI elements across the retention boundary; window-level selection instead preserves the local structure that accurate action grounding requires.
blocks.zh: 图5显示STP-GUI在具有代表性的Online-Mind2Web任务的4个相继步骤上对符号选择的定性可视化。 由于Online-Mind2Web和AitW不为完整的轨迹提供密集的每步目标说明,成功的交互路径也并非独一无二,所以我们不把此类例子当作数据集级的度量. 相反,我们手动整理了几个成功的在线-Mind2Web事件作为案例研究,并对这些代表性步骤的分级地面实况目标作了说明,并将其与保留的象征性区域进行比较。 在这些情况下,选择者将象征性预算集中在空间相通的区域(导航菜单、产品卡和定价表)上,同时放弃大面积的统一背景。 选择窗口级别可以保留精确行动着陆所需的局部结构。

blocks.en: To further investigate how different pruning strategies affect the spatial structure of retained visual evidence, we provide additional visualizations for 5 representative methods: FlashVLM, PDrop, HiPrune, Attention, and IVC. Figures 6 , 10 , 7 , 8 , and 9 show the retained-token patterns of these methods across all execution steps of the same GUI interaction episode(In fact, this example task can be completed in just 4 steps.). Instead of presenting only a single-step snapshot, each large figure visualizes the full step-by-step pruning behavior of one method throughout the entire interaction process.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步调查不同的穿透策略如何影响所保留的视觉证据的空间结构,我们为5个代表性方法提供了额外的可视化:FlashVLM,PDrop,HiPrune,Content,和IVC. 图6、图10、图7、图8和图9显示同一GUI互动插曲中所有执行步骤中这些方法的保留模式( 事实上,这个例子任务只需四个步骤即可完成. ). 每个大人物不只呈现出单步快照,而是在整个互动过程中将一种方法的全部分步爬行行为可视化.

blocks.en: These full-process visualizations are useful for examining whether a pruning strategy preserves spatially coherent local evidence or gradually degenerates into fragmented token retention over time. This distinction is particularly important for GUI grounding, where accurate action prediction often depends not only on the target region itself, but also on nearby contextual cues such as surrounding text, icons, and local layout structure. As a result, methods that retain visually scattered fragments may fail to preserve the structured local evidence needed for reliable grounding, even when using a similar token budget.
blocks.zh: 这些全过程可视化对于审查一个穿透策略是否保留了空间上一致的局部证据,或者逐渐退化成一段时间后零散的象征保留,是有用的. 这种区分对于GUI定位特别重要,因为准确的行动预测往往不仅取决于目标区域本身,而且还取决于附近的背景提示,如周围的文字、图标和当地布局结构。 因此,保留视觉上分散的碎片的方法可能无法保存可靠地基所需的结构化当地证据,即使使用了类似的象征性预算。

blocks.en: Overall, these visualizations provide complementary qualitative evidence to the quantitative results in the main paper. By comparing the retained-token patterns across multiple execution steps, we can more clearly observe the different fragmentation behaviors induced by different pruning strategies and better understand how preserving local spatial coherence may benefit GUI agents.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,这些可视化为主要论文中的定量结果提供了补充性的质量证据. 通过在多个执行步骤中比较保留-托肯模式,我们可以更清楚地观察到不同穿插策略所引发的不同分解行为,并更清楚地了解如何保持本地空间一致性可能有利于GUI代理.
